papers.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
papers.summary: SpatialScout evaluates vision-language agents on active 3D object mapping, revealing major gaps in precise metric map construction.

papers.title: From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation
papers.summary: SERA improves long-horizon robotic manipulation by using an editable harness to maintain task context and evolve planning through execution feedback, paired with a fixed low-level VLA executor.

papers.title: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
papers.summary: CompactSplat is a feedforward framework that adaptively allocates 3D Gaussians via texture-guided spatial partitioning and hierarchical sampling, improving geometry and texture recovery while allowing dynamic sparsity control.

papers.title: Right Screen, Wrong Transition: World Models as Verifiers for GUI Agents
papers.summary: A decoder-free, action-conditioned world model predicts next-screen representations to verify GUI transitions and detect hijacked screens with high accuracy and low latency.

papers.title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
papers.summary: PACE is a post-hoc four-bit quantizer for linear-attention recurrent states that rounds less frequently and uses column-wise scales to reduce error, enabling lower memory usage without fine-tuning.
